content.rendered:
Lucknow is one of north India’s fastest-growing industrial and logistics cities. The UPSIDA industrial belt along the Kanpur Road — Amausi, Nadarganj, and the Sarojini Nagar industrial estates — is expanding, and the warehousing and logistics sector around the city is growing alongside it. Add the steady volume of government and infrastructure projects across Uttar Pradesh’s capital, and you have a market with a real and rising need for container offices: site offices, security cabins, administrative units, and project workspace.

SAMAN manufactures steel container offices and supplies them across Lucknow. We build at our facility in Greater Noida — well within the north India delivery belt — and dispatch to your UPSIDA unit, warehouse, or project site. For government and infrastructure vendors who need proper procurement documentation, and for industrial buyers who need a durable site-ready office, we supply both the unit and the paperwork.

Explore container office range, sizes and pricing or call us to discuss your requirement.

Who Buys a Container Office in Lucknow

A container office is a finished steel workspace — built from a refabricated shipping container or a new container-style steel frame — that arrives wired, insulated, and ready to use. No civil construction, no waiting. In Lucknow’s growing industrial economy the buyers are clear:

UPSIDA industrial units in the Amausi-Nadarganj belt use container offices as factory administrative cabins, security posts, and overflow workspace as they set up and expand.

Warehousing and logistics operators along the Kanpur Road corridor place container offices at warehouse and yard entries for dispatch supervision and gate control. A site office container for project deployment suits operations that need a workspace fast.

Infrastructure and construction contractors building across Lucknow and the wider UP region need a project manager’s site office and a security cabin — durable, lockable, and movable when the project shifts.

Government and PWD project vendors use deployable container offices as field offices, and value a certified manufacturer that supplies the documentation a government procurement file requires.

Lucknow’s Industrial Zones — Where We Deliver

Telling us your delivery zone lets us plan the route and quote accurate freight. We deliver across the Lucknow industrial region, including:

Amausi / Nadarganj Industrial Area (PIN 226008): The established UPSIDA industrial belt on the Kanpur Road near the airport, hosting engineering, manufacturing, and MSME units. Container offices here serve as factory cabins, security posts, and contractor offices.

Sarojini Nagar UPSIDA estate (PIN 226008): The adjacent UPSIDC/UPSIDA industrial estate on the Kanpur Road corridor, part of the same growing industrial belt.

Kanpur Road logistics corridor: The warehousing and logistics belt running between Lucknow and Kanpur — a growing freight and distribution zone where yard offices and security cabins are in demand.

Outside these zones, we deliver to construction, industrial, and government project sites across the Lucknow region wherever a crane or forklift can place the unit.

Sizes and Specifications

Built for a Lucknow industrial, logistics, or government project site.

Structure: Refabricated ISO shipping container OR new IS 2062 grade steel frame, anti-rust treated and painted
Insulation: PUF panel or rock wool lining — handles UP’s hot summers and cold winters
Roofing: Container roof with weather sealing, or sloped GI over-roof
Flooring: Marine plywood, vinyl, or anti-skid steel
Electrical: Wiring, MCB board, LED lights, fan and AC points to your declared load
Windows: Sliding glass with MS safety grille; mesh ventilation
Doors: Container door retained for storage-office combos, or MS/glass entry door

Common sizes for Lucknow delivery:

SizeTypical use
10 ftSecurity cabin or single-desk office
20 ftStandard site office — most common
40 ftLarge office, or office + storage combination
20 ft + partitionOffice plus records or meeting room
40 ft modularJoined units for larger workspace

Custom layouts and partitions are built to your site footprint.

Customisation

Everything is built and fitted at our Greater Noida factory before dispatch — so the unit arrives complete and needs no on-site assembly.

  • Internal partition walls for separate rooms
  • Air conditioner provision — cut-out, bracket, copper sleeve, drain
  • Insulation upgrade for UP summer heat and winter cold
  • Full electrical fit-out with MCB, sockets, LED, fan points
  • Insulated false ceiling for temperature control
  • Attached toilet module with FRP tank and plumbing
  • Pantry counter for longer-stay site offices
  • Anti-corrosion treatment for outdoor durability
  • Exterior paint and department or company branding panel

Why Buy From SAMAN

We manufacture our own container offices — most suppliers serving Lucknow are dealers reselling units with no certification or warranty.

  • ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management (E20250218645)
  • ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management (E20250218646)
  • ISO 45001:2018 Occupational Health & Safety (E20250218647)
  • NSIC: NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207
  • DPIIT: DIPP56005
  • GST (North): 09ABBCS7101B1ZT

Structural frame warranty: 5 years. Finishing: 1–2 years. Engineered service life: 20–25 years. Over 500 projects since 2009.

For government, UPSIDA, and infrastructure vendors who need vendor documentation for a tender or supply order, we provide ISO certificate copies, NSIC registration, DPIIT recognition, and GST papers with your order — the paperwork a procurement file typically requires.

Price Factors

No fixed published price — every container office is built to specification. Cost depends on:

  • Converted shipping container vs new steel-frame build
  • Size (10 ft / 20 ft / 40 ft)
  • Insulation and climate-protection level
  • Electrical and AC fit-out
  • Partition, toilet, and pantry additions
  • Anti-corrosion treatment for long-term outdoor use

Freight from Greater Noida to Lucknow is quoted as a separate, transparent line item — and because Lucknow is within the north India belt, freight is reasonable. For larger or multi-unit orders the per-unit freight is more efficient. Send your size and use for a written quotation with full breakup within 24 hours.

You can also see a modular container office for phased expansion if your operation grows in stages.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the price of a container office in Lucknow?

Price depends on size, whether it is a converted shipping container or a new steel-frame build, the insulation and AC fit-out, and any partition or toilet additions. A basic 20 ft unit costs less than a 40 ft fully-fitted office. Because Lucknow is within the north India belt, freight from our Greater Noida factory is reasonable and quoted as a separate line. Call +91 87960 39938 for a written quotation with full breakup within 24 hours.

Can you deliver a container office to the Amausi or Nadarganj UPSIDA area?

Yes. We deliver to the Amausi / Nadarganj Industrial Area (PIN 226008), the Sarojini Nagar UPSIDA estate, the Kanpur Road logistics corridor, and all Lucknow industrial, construction, and government project addresses. For UPSIDA estate or government site deliveries needing gate-pass or entry authorisation, share the procedure when you order and we coordinate the delivery vehicle with your site.

Do you supply container offices for government and UPSIDA projects in Lucknow?

Yes. We supply deployable site offices and security cabins for government, PWD, UPSIDA, and infrastructure projects across Lucknow. We provide the vendor documentation — ISO certificates, NSIC registration, DPIIT recognition, GST papers — that a tender or procurement file requires. Mention the documentation requirement when you place the order so we include it with the delivery paperwork.

How quickly can you deliver to Lucknow from your Greater Noida factory?

Standard sizes are typically ready in 7–12 working days from order confirmation. Lucknow is within the north India delivery belt from our Greater Noida factory, so transit is short relative to far-zone cities. Custom fit-out with AC, partition, and toilet adds a few working days to production. We confirm the dispatch and delivery dates in writing when you order.

Call or Send an Enquiry

For a container office in Lucknow — manufactured by SAMAN, delivered from Greater Noida:

+91 87960 39938 | +91 97089 89937

Call or WhatsApp. Same working day response. Include your size, use, and delivery zone for a complete quotation without a follow-up call.
